papers.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
papers.problem: AI text drafters must wait for the main model before drafting again, so decoding stays slow.
papers.fix: D3D drafts ahead without waiting, reaching 5.00 times and 5.71 times faster decoding on two Qwen3 models.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, you can serve large models much faster, so test asynchronous drafting in your serving stack.
papers.limitation: The tests cover Qwen3 models on seven benchmarks, so other model families remain unproven.

papers.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
papers.problem: Long-context AI models spend most decode time scanning the cache to pick which tokens each layer reads.
papers.fix: Reusing the previous layer's picks lets the scan run alongside attention, giving up to 14.5% faster decoding with no retraining.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, long prompts get cheaper to serve, so try it on DeepSeek-V3.2 or GLM-5.
papers.limitation: Gains were tested only on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5, and accuracy drops a few percentage points.

papers.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
papers.problem: No simple formula told people what each token costs in energy, so AI power bills were hard to predict.
papers.fix: A four-parameter law predicts LLM energy with 11.97% error, and agentic requests use 13.0 times more energy.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, long agent loops are your biggest energy cost, so cut input length first.
papers.limitation: The model was fitted on 13 dense LLMs running on NVIDIA H100 GPUs only.

papers.title: TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation
papers.problem: Live talking digital humans render high-resolution video slowly, and new text can interrupt their speech.
papers.fix: TaoMate-HD sketches video at low resolution first, runs 1.6 times faster, and cuts speech errors by 11.18 points.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, real-time avatars become cheaper to run, so use staged low-to-high resolution generation.
papers.limitation: The excerpt reports speed and speech accuracy only, with no human rating of video quality.

papers.title: Islamic Social Financial Instruments and Sustainable Community Development: Evidence Synthesis on Community Resilience
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Research on zakat, waqf and sadaqah is scattered, so nobody knows how they build community resilience together.
papers.fix: Across 93 studies, zakat gives quick relief, waqf builds lasting assets, and sadaqah covers sudden emergencies.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, combine all three tools in one programme, and back it with strong governance and digital systems.
papers.limitation: This is a review of past studies, so it shows patterns, not new proof of cause.

papers.title: Trends and Determinants of Sustainability Sukuk Issuance: Evidence from Global Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Sustainability sukuk are growing fast, but nobody knew what makes one issue bigger than another.
papers.fix: Across 11,944 sukuk from 2012 to 2022, equity-based contracts, USD or Euro currency, and social purposes gave larger issues.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, issuers should pick equity-based contracts and major currencies, and watch the cost of second party opinions.
papers.limitation: The data ends in 2022, and most growth sits in Indonesia, Malaysia and Saudi Arabia.

papers.title: Sustainability Committees and Environmental Initiatives: Insights from Dual Banking Systems in Emerging Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks form sustainability committees, but it was unclear whether they bring real environmental results in dual banking markets.
papers.fix: Committees raise environmental scores in all banks, yet in Islamic banks they mostly move symbolic scores, not green products.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, regulators should check Islamic banks for real green products, not only committee scores.
papers.limitation: Panel regressions show links, not cause, and cover emerging markets with both bank types only.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Strategies to Enhance Islamic Banks’ Competitiveness and Sustainable Development
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Islamic banks in Jordan lacked proof that AI and big data actually improve competitiveness and sustainable development.
papers.fix: In a survey of 214 managers, AI, big data analytics and data management practices all raised competitiveness and sustainability.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, invest in AI systems and data management, since staff digital skill alone did not lift sustainability.
papers.limitation: The survey covers Jordanian Islamic banks at one point in time, so it shows links, not cause.

papers.title: ICT, High-Tech Exports, and Institutions as Drivers of Bank Expansion Growth in a Dual Banking System
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: It was unclear which technology and institution factors help Islamic and conventional banks expand.
papers.fix: Across 218 banks in 12 countries, ICT adoption drove bank growth most, while high-tech exports helped only alongside ICT.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, banks should invest in digital infrastructure first, and regulators should keep governance strong, especially for Islamic banks.
papers.limitation: The data covers 2010 to 2023 in 12 countries, so other markets may differ.

papers.title: Procrastination among US college students: Prevalence and impact relative to common health and life issues
papers.problem: Nobody knew how common student procrastination is, or how much it hurts compared with other life issues.
papers.fix: Procrastination hit 72.3% of 65,950 US students, and 45.4% said it harmed their grades.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, procrastination is a bigger grade problem than money or ADHD, so fix it before other habits.
papers.limitation: The data comes from self-reported surveys of US students, so other countries and workers may differ.

papers.title: “The significance of context”: Fit, friction, and function in the work lives of early career academics with ADHD
papers.problem: Little was known about how ADHD shapes early-career academics' work lives, since most views treat ADHD as a medical problem.
papers.fix: Academia can reward ADHD minds, but social and institutional pressure often blocks that, and ADHD academics may help collective knowledge.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, pick workplaces that fit how you work, and ask for flexibility to use your strengths.
papers.limitation: This interview study covers early-career academics only, so it shows experiences, not measured effects.
